universities.name: University of Delhi (DU)
universities.description: Collegiate central research university recognized as an Institute of Eminence by UGC. Renowned for academic excellence in arts, commerce, and scientific research.

colleges.name: St. Stephen's College
colleges.description: Premier constituent college of DU known for liberal arts, physical sciences, and historic alumni leadership.
colleges.facilities: Heritage Chapel, Modern Science Laboratories, Air-conditioned Library, Olympic Tennis Courts, Multi-cuisine Cafeteria, Residential Halls

colleges.name: Shri Ram College of Commerce (SRCC)
colleges.description: India's highest-ranked institution for undergraduate commerce and economics education with top global campus recruitments.
colleges.facilities: Central Air-Conditioning, Bloomberg Financial Terminals, Indoor Sports Complex, Digital Resource Center, Placement Hub

colleges.name: Hindu College
colleges.description: Consistently ranked #1 college in India by NIRF. Offers celebrated programs across sciences, social sciences, and humanities.
colleges.facilities: Research Centre, Amphitheater, State-of-the-art Auditorium, High-speed Wi-Fi Campus, Sports Pavillion, Girls & Boys Hostels

universities.name: Indian Institute of Technology Delhi (IIT Delhi)
universities.description: Autonomous public institute of technology declared an Institute of National Importance. Globally celebrated for engineering innovation, start-up incubation, and computing research.

colleges.name: IIT Delhi School of Engineering & Technology
colleges.description: Leading faculty producing world-class engineers, computer scientists, and technologists.
colleges.facilities: Supercomputing Facility, Nanotechnology Center, Advanced Robotics Lab, 24/7 Library, Swimming Pool, 13 Hostels

colleges.name: Department of Management Studies (DMS IITD)
colleges.description: Top-ranked management school bridging technological depth with strategic global management leadership.
colleges.facilities: Management Simulation Lab, Corporate Boardrooms, Research Repository, Executive Suites

universities.name: Indian Institute of Science (IISc Bangalore)
universities.description: India's highest-ranked university in global QS & Times Higher Education rankings. Pioneer in scientific discovery, deep tech research, and aerospace engineering.

colleges.name: IISc Division of Electrical, Electronics & Computer Sciences (EECS)
colleges.description: The nation's apex division for computing, artificial intelligence, quantum computing, and communication systems.
colleges.facilities: Param Pravega Supercomputer, Quantum Hardware Labs, Clean Rooms, Green Campus, Lush Botanical Gardens

colleges.name: IISc Division of Chemical & Biological Sciences
colleges.description: Premier interdisciplinary research division dedicated to molecular biophysics, genomics, and chemical ecology.
colleges.facilities: Cryo-EM Facility, Mass Spectrometry Center, NMR Spectroscopy Lab, Bioreactor Suites

universities.name: Birla Institute of Technology and Science (BITS Pilani)
universities.description: Eminent deemed university with campuses in Pilani, Goa, Hyderabad, and Dubai. Known for zero attendance policy, student autonomy, and stellar tech unicorn founders.

colleges.name: BITS Pilani K.K. Birla Goa Campus
colleges.description: Scenic campus by the Zuari river delivering cutting-edge engineering curriculum and premier campus placement track records.
colleges.facilities: Modern Tech Sandbox, High-speed Gigabit Wi-Fi, Student Innovation Center, Medical Clinic, Football Turf

colleges.name: BITS Pilani Hyderabad Campus
colleges.description: Modern 200-acre smart campus in Telangana with state-of-the-art semiconductor and pharmaceutical research centers.
colleges.facilities: Microelectronics Cleanrooms, Incubation & Entrepreneurship Cell, Air-Conditioned Auditoriums, Modern Hostels

universities.name: Anna University
universities.description: Affiliating university for engineering, technology, and applied sciences in Tamil Nadu, hosting the historic College of Engineering Guindy.

colleges.name: College of Engineering, Guindy (CEG)
colleges.description: Founded in 1794, CEG is the oldest technical institution in Asia, renowned for core engineering disciplines and industry ties.
colleges.facilities: Ramanujan Computing Centre, Central Workshop, Historic Red Stone Building, 16 Student Hostels, Modern Gym

colleges.name: Madras Institute of Technology (MIT Chromepet)
colleges.description: Alma mater of Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam, famous for aeronautical engineering, automobile technology, and instrumentation.
colleges.facilities: Flight Simulator, Aircraft Hangar, Automotive Testing Track, CAD/CAM Labs

universities.name: Jadavpur University
universities.description: Eminent public university celebrated for world-class technical education at remarkably affordable public fee structures.

colleges.name: Faculty of Engineering & Technology (FET Jadavpur)
colleges.description: Top-tier engineering faculty ranked among India's elite for computer science, robotics, and patent publications.
colleges.facilities: Blue Heron Lake, High Performance Computing Center, Digital Library, Salt Lake Campus Hostels, Placement Cell

universities.name: University of Mumbai
universities.description: One of India's oldest and premier collegiate state universities, offering accredited degrees to hundreds of thousands of students across the Mumbai Metropolitan Region.

colleges.name: Veermata Jijabai Technological Institute (VJTI)
colleges.description: Autonomous public engineering institute located in Matunga, Mumbai. Renowned for civil, electrical, and computer engineering.
colleges.facilities: IoT Innovation Lab, Historic Clock Tower Campus, Textile Technology Plant, 4 Hostels, Central Library

colleges.name: St. Xavier's College (Autonomous)
colleges.description: Prestigious autonomous institution housed in magnificent Indo-Gothic architecture in South Mumbai, renowned for arts, science, and management.
colleges.facilities: Caius Research Lab, The Woods Amphitheater, Historic Reference Library, Malhar Festival Ground, Heritage Hall

universities.name: Symbiosis International University
universities.description: Multi-campus deemed university renowned for management, computer applications, law, and international student diversity.

colleges.name: Symbiosis Institute of Business Management (SIBM)
colleges.description: Flagship B-school situated atop the picturesque Lavale Hills, consistently ranked among India's top 10 MBA institutions.
colleges.facilities: Hilltop Residential Campus, Swimming Pool, Bloomberg Finance Terminal, Amphitheater, Executive Dining

colleges.name: Symbiosis Institute of Technology (SIT)
colleges.description: Modern technical school emphasizing project-oriented learning, robotics, and cloud computing partnerships.
colleges.facilities: Smart Robotics Laboratory, Apple iOS Developer Center, High-speed Campus Wi-Fi, Modern Gym, Hostels
